Track 31 is a patch Job on Audacity using Tracks 12 and 22. There's a remix featuring the group Tré, the church singers from "Tha Crossroads" video but the remix was only released with the clean version's vocals. In order for me to make this work, The last line of Wish Bone's 3rd verse had to be the clean version's line. Tré's vocals came in before he finished the verse.
